title: Finding code caves
description:
Find runs of unused bytes in an executable section that could hold a few extra instructions.

```
.text: caves of at least 16 bytes
  0x1A30  32 bytes of CC
  0x1C90  48 bytes of 00
.data: skipped (not executable)
```
hints: Walk the bytes; while the byte equals the run's filler, extend; otherwise close the run and start again (lesson 4.03).
The bytes just after a function's `ret` are often `CC` padding the compiler added for alignment.
requirements: Look for runs of `00` or `CC` of at least a given length.
Report the offset, length and filler byte.
stretch: Leave a few bytes at each end of a cave unused, in case the padding is really part of something.
